title: Edmund and the Echo
author: Bram Vane
blurb: Cyrus Pemberton, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
